**FINDING #10 (fixed, PR #228) + doctrine: gate tests inject ALL evidence sources EXCEPT the one the test exists to prove**

What: Finding #10 — hermeticity bug in tests shipped in PR #227 (merged to feature/v2.0.0 @ 0868362), fixed in PR #228 (test-only, Part of #226, type:chore, all REQUIRED gates green). Two memory-gate tests expecting FAIL injected `readChunks` but not `readRecords`, so the runner default `readRecords` read the REAL `.memory/records/`. Passed on the tracker (no records/); once real records/ existed on the cutover branch the gate wrongly PASSED and the fail-expecting test FAILED — verdict coupled to committed memory state.

Fix (PR #228): all 5 memory-gate tests inject BOTH readers; rule encoded in run-check.test.mjs header. Reproduced hermetically (no real-store mutation); post-fix the file passes even run from a cwd WITH records/ present. Full suite 1049 pass.

TWO CLASSES OF COUPLING — the doctrine rule distinguishes them:
1. ACCIDENTAL (finding #10, a BUG, fixed): a test left an I/O dep at its default and silently inherited real repo state it never meant to test. Must be eliminated — inject the source.
2. INTENTIONAL + DOCUMENTED (out of scope, correct as-is): the decision-gate ci-context-seam test ("deps.ctx.baseSha/headSha take precedence...") runs real `git diff HEAD...HEAD` on purpose — real git IS the thing under test; passes in-repo, "fails" only if forced from a non-git dir. This coupling is deliberate and documented, NOT a bug.

DOCTRINE RULE (human ruling — register in catalog / testing doctrine): a pure-check runner's tests inject ALL evidence sources EXCEPT the single source the test EXISTS to prove. Corollary for runCheck memory-gate: whoever injects one gate reader injects both. Any dep left at its default couples the verdict to ambient repo state (real .memory/ or real git) — allowed only when that coupling is the test's explicit subject.

Where: brain/scripts/governance/run-check.test.mjs (header + 5 memory-gate tests). PRs: #227 (shipped the bug, merged), #228 (the repair). Related: [[governance/memory-gate-records-aware]], unblocks cutover #225.
